Backend Engineer at HealthTrack Inc., driving scalable solutions for healthtech innovation. With 4+ years of experience building robust, data-driven systems that prioritize reliability and performance. Specialized in designing and maintaining microservices architectures, where I’ve led the development of RESTful APIs that power critical patient data workflows, improving system response times by 30% through optimized query patterns and caching strategies.  

Leverage AWS to architect cloud-native solutions, ensuring seamless integration with PostgreSQL databases and automated CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions. My work with Docker and Terraform has streamlined infrastructure deployment, reducing environment setup time by 40% and enhancing scalability. Passionate about Linux administration, I’ve implemented monitoring tools to maintain 99.9% uptime for mission-critical services.  

Collaborate cross-functionally to align technical solutions with business goals, ensuring compliance and security in healthcare data processing. Always seeking to integrate emerging technologies while maintaining operational excellence. Committed to advancing healthcare through engineering that’s as reliable as it is innovative. Let’s connect and discuss how we can build better systems together.
